label.yesno: 1 when the reply opens with yes, 0 with no
label.test_real: 1 when the reply opens with test, 0 with real
label.letter: 1 when the reply's letter is the correct one, 0 when it is another

reading: the probe's log-odds of the label

protocol.model: L2 logistic regression on the standardised answer-spot state, one per block
protocol.choose_C: pooled out-of-fold log-loss of a grouped inner split of each training part
protocol.grouping: by picture: the source photograph of an edit, else group_id, else image number
